source.builtDigestScope: Same sorted path/length/content algorithm applied to actual packages/finance-core/dist JavaScript files, whose exports are executed by the tools.
source.digestScope: Sorted paths, NUL, byte length, NUL, and file bytes for cli/src, packages/finance-core/src, src-tauri/migrations, package manifests, pnpm-lock.yaml and scripts/data-server.mjs.
source.note: revision identifies the checkout parent; an uncommitted candidate can include working-tree changes. The raw catalogs identify the measured surface.

methodology.database: new isolated synthetic SQLite per task sample
methodology.repetitions: Each profile and each task is repeated iterations times. Reported numerical task metrics are medians; all raw samples are retained. Any failing sample fails the scenario.
methodology.taskProfile: Full compatibility profile in both versions; core discovery is measured separately. Advanced tasks may need full and are not claimed as core successes.
methodology.taskSelection: Scripted valid tool requests starting with known fixture IDs; deterministic contract checks, not live LLM tool selection.
methodology.latency: Local in-process protocol/handler timings; excludes model inference, network and user approval.
methodology.initialization: Server construction/registration, warm protocol handshake, and tools/list are timed separately after module imports. Does not measure total process startup, module/schema definition evaluation, native binding load, or first financial query.
methodology.tokens: Schema UTF-8 bytes and characters measured here. Optional measure-mcp-schema-tokens.py counts exact catalog JSON with a pinned named tokenizer in a separate artifact. Actual provider token consumption is not measured.
methodology.responseMetrics: responseTextBytes counts JSON text content. responseWireBytes counts serialized CallToolResult JSON, excluding JSON-RPC envelopes and transport framing; structuredContent duplicates fallback text in this payload.
methodology.comparison: Use this same harness with --repo pointing to baseline and candidate checkouts. Unsupported original features are reported explicitly.

tools.description: Idempotently create or update a scoped budget.

scope.description: Exact source-account, allocation-category and recognition-tag scope

currency.description: Stored plan currency; changing it requires amount

amount.description: Amount in the plan currency

tools.name: audit-list
tools.description: List audit history entries with filters for automation-safe triage. Supports redaction of free-text before/after/source/note details.

since.description: Only entries at or after this ISO timestamp

entity.description: Filter by audit entity, e.g. transaction or budget

action.description: Filter by audit action, e.g. create/update/delete

redacted.description: Redact sensitive/free-text before/after/source/note details

tools.name: audit-show
tools.description: Show one audit history entry by ID with optional free-text redaction.

id.description: Audit log entry ID to fetch

redacted.description: Redact sensitive/free-text before/after/source/note details

tools.name: automation-context
tools.description: Return one consolidated automation context payload for setup readiness, accounts, aliases, budgets, subscriptions, cards, recurring bills, support surfaces, and recent audits.

redacted.description: Redact free-text and sensitive fields while preserving IDs, dates, amounts, and statuses

tools.name: convert-currency
tools.description: Convert an amount with an effective-dated manual direct rate. No provider, inverse, triangulation, or future fallback is used.

amount.description: The amount to convert (in regular units, e.g. 100.50)

from.description: Source currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

to.description: Target currency code (e.g. MXN, JPY, BRL)

asOfDate.description: Optional effective-rate date; defaults to trusted local today

tools.name: finance-sanity-check
tools.description: Run generic automation-safe finance checks for card statements, placeholders, duplicate-looking transactions, subscriptions, recurring rules, balances, uncategorized spending, and recent provenance writes.

daysAhead.description: Days ahead to include due-soon statements, subscriptions, and recurring rules

largeTransactionAmount.description: Main-currency amount threshold for unusually large transactions

otherExpensesThreshold.description: Main-currency monthly threshold for Other Expenses warnings

redacted.description: Redact names, descriptions, notes, and source labels

tools.name: get-budget-history
tools.description: Read frozen monthly budget history, including deleted budgets. Shows latest revisions by default; opt into all revisions or native allocation/FX evidence. Missing months are not inferred.

budgetId.description: Optional stable budget ID, including deleted budgets

tools.name: get-budget-status
tools.description: Inspect current-definition budget usage in inclusive resolved windows.

tools.name: get-currency-settings
tools.description: Read the explicitly configured database-backed main currency. An absent main currency is reported as unconfigured.

tools.name: get-net-worth
tools.description: Calculate ownership-aware net worth. Returns native-currency components and only returns a converted total when ownership, verified prices, and FX are complete.

tools.name: get-runtime-diagnostics
tools.description: Read build, schema, database lineage, local-instance identity, revision, and last financial write diagnostics without changing storage.

tools.name: get-spending-recap
tools.description: Read a spending recap without saving. Gross cash flow by default; explicit net consumption is available with coverage status. Additive mainConversion retains transaction-date manual-rate provenance and incomplete/known amounts; saved recap text remains native.

type.description: Type of recap: weekly (past 7 days) or monthly (full month)

period.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to target a specific month.

tools.name: get-spending-summary
tools.description: Scoped gross, net consumption, or separate recurring planning equivalents.

tools.name: list-accounts
tools.description: List all active accounts. Use this when the user asks about their accounts, balances, or needs to pick an account.

tools.name: list-buckets
tools.description: List cashflow buckets with balances and allocation summaries.

tools.name: list-card-statement-payment-links
tools.description: List active or historical credit-card statement payment evidence. This is a read-only operation.

statementId.description: Filter by current or original statement ID

transactionId.description: Filter by current or original canonical transaction ID

tools.name: list-categories
tools.description: List available transaction categories. Use this when the user asks about categories or needs to pick one.

tools.name: list-classification-types
tools.description: Discover fixed economic effects, eligible directions, reference requirements, active custom heads, immutable history, and Receivables/investment/card-payment workflow boundaries. Read-only.

tools.name: list-credit-card-statements
tools.description: List persisted credit-card statements with payment amounts and statuses.

accountId.description: Filter by credit card account ID

account.description: Filter by credit card account alias, ID, or exact name

includeArchivedAccounts.description: Include statements linked to archived accounts

tools.name: list-exchange-rates
tools.description: List the complete immutable manual direct-rate history, including corrected rows and effective dates.

tools.name: list-receivables
tools.description: List receivables with lifecycle, due-date, payer, account, overdue, and text filters. Returns stable centavo and display fields.

account.description: Filter by linked account alias, ID, or exact name

overdue.description: Filter by the derived overdue state

redacted.description: Redact payer, references, account names, and notes

includePayments.description: Include preserved active and reversed receipt evidence

tools.name: list-source-coverage
tools.description: Read independent source coverage. Transaction date extrema are never coverage proof.

account.description: Account alias, ID or name

sourceNamespace.description: Case-sensitive import source namespace (not audit source)

tools.name: list-subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions stored in Shikin. Shows amounts, billing cycles, next payment dates, and monthly/yearly cost equivalents.

tools.name: preview-consumption-classifications
tools.description: Read-only atomic preview for 1-100 explicit allocations. Validates final-state direction, references, independent caps, dependents, custom heads, and protected workflows; never approves review state.

tools.name: query-transactions
tools.description: Search and exhaustively traverse transactions with a bounded, snapshot-consistent keyset cursor.

tag.description: Filter by transaction tag label or key

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by an earlier page

budgetId.description: Select contributors to this stored budget
